submitted.rationale: Of the three measured compositions, Cu0.47Sb0.53 had the highest EQE (0.0057%). It is somewhat Cu-rich compared with CuSb2O6. The Cu0.34 sample was close to phase-pure CuSb2O6 by XRD but gave a lower EQE (0.0043%). Going further Cu-rich to Cu0.60 made the EQE negative (-0.006%), which is not photoanodic. XRD at Cu0.57 showed extra Cu-rich phases.

rejected.reason: near phase-pure CuSb2O6 but lower EQE, 0.0043%
XRD at index 22 showed antimony oxide phases, which absorb poorly at 2.1 eV
